name: Social Content Pipeline — Slack to LinkedIn/X

nodes.name: Schedule (3x Daily)
nodes.notes: Runs at 9am, 1pm, 5pm ET. Adjust timezone in n8n settings.

nodes.name: Read Slack Messages
nodes.notes: Reads messages from the last 8 hours. Configure channel IDs below.

nodes.name: Set Slack Channels
nodes.notes: Add your Slack channel IDs here. Find them in Slack channel settings.

nodes.name: Merge All Messages
nodes.notes: Combines messages from all channels into a single array for Claude.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens: 4096, system: $('Load Scanner Prompt').item.json.prompt_text, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Here are the Slack messages to scan:\n\n' + JSON.stringify($json.all_messages) }] }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 1: Claude Slack Scanner
nodes.notes: Sends all Slack messages to Claude with the scanner system prompt. Returns identified topics as JSON.

nodes.name: Load Scanner Prompt
nodes.notes: Alternative: paste the prompt directly into a Set node instead of reading from file.

nodes.name: Parse Topics
nodes.notes: Parses Claude's JSON response into individual topic items. Filters out empty scans.

nodes.name: Has Topics?
nodes.notes: Routes to content creation if topics found, otherwise stops.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens: 4096, system: $('Load Creator Prompt').item.json.prompt_text, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Create social media posts for this topic:\n\n' + JSON.stringify({ topic: $json, screenshots: $json.has_screenshots ? 'Screenshots are attached — reference them in posts' : 'No screenshots available' }) }] }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 2: Claude Content Creator
nodes.notes: Sends each topic to Claude to generate LinkedIn + X post drafts.

nodes.name: Load Creator Prompt
nodes.notes: Alternative: paste the prompt directly into a Set node.

nodes.name: Agent 3: Format Approval Message
nodes.notes: Formats the draft posts into a clean Slack message for approval.

nodes.name: Send to Slack for Approval
nodes.notes: Posts the draft to your approval channel. Set the channel ID.

nodes.name: Wait for Approval Reaction
nodes.notes: SEPARATE WORKFLOW: This triggers when someone reacts to the approval message. Start a new workflow with this trigger.

nodes.name: Is Approved?
nodes.notes: Checks if the reaction is a checkmark (approved).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ author: 'urn:li:organization:' + $env.LINKEDIN_ORG_ID, lifecycleState: 'PUBLISHED', specificContent: { 'com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent': { shareCommentary: { text: $json.linkedin_post.text + '\n\n' + $json.linkedin_post.hashtags.join(' ') }, shareMediaCategory: 'NONE' } }, visibility: { 'com.linkedin.ugc.MemberNetworkVisibility': 'PUBLIC' } }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 4: Post to LinkedIn
nodes.notes: Posts approved content to LinkedIn via API. Requires LinkedIn OAuth2 credentials.

nodes.name: Agent 4: Post to X
nodes.notes: Posts approved content to X. Requires X/Twitter OAuth2 credentials.

nodes.name: Confirm in Slack
nodes.notes: Sends a confirmation message after posting.
